agent.problem: The card opens with Paul's first-person quotation and identifies him only afterward. Paul needs to be named before the quotation.

rule.text: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.

agent.problem: The blank reproduces the end of a line the baker has not seen, and the earlier cards do not provide a way to reason out salvation rather than leadership or success. It is a wording guess rather than a meaning-based blank.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
